name: amazon-ads-sb-performance-review
description: Produce a Sponsored Brands (SB) campaign performance review from SB Campaigns Report data: portfolio summary, top and worst campaigns by efficiency, low-CTR creative signals, new-to-brand (NTB) analysis when present, placement or format splits if columns exist, and actionable recommendations. Use when users ask for Sponsored Brands audits, SB headline/video/store spotlight reviews, brand awareness efficiency, NTB share, SB CTR vs benchmarks, or SB campaign deep-dives. The agent must fetch and parse the report for the user’s environment — do not assume a global variable, fixed file path, or stable Amazon export schema; write loader and column-mapping code after inspecting the actual artifact.
